stepTitle: A confidence interval for the mean trip duration in $$2019$$.
stepBody: A simple random sample of $$500$$ taxi trips in Anytown is taken on May $$1$$, $$2018$$. The data matrix for this sample has $$4$$ columns: number of blocks, total distance, fare, and the duration of the trip.\nCan you reliably compute the above via bootstrapping, using this $$4$$ column sample from May $$1$$ as well as the original $$3$$ column population dataset for all of $$2018$$.
